reported: turn error unknown prompt variable "{{cwd}}" in section "deployment:persona-prefix"; registered variables: provider, model
rootCause: The shipped mpd preset's persona prefix ended with 'Your working directory is {{cwd}}.' The harness loop registers only provider and model as prompt variables; dsh-persona registers the prefix with strict interpolation, so the unknown reference throws during prompt assembly before any model request. The installed dsh-system-prompt README states custom persona templates must not depend on a built-in {{cwd}}.
fix: Removed the {{cwd}} clause from presets/mpd.patch.yml's persona prefix and corrected the adjacent comment. The harness working-directory service already supplies the current directory as literal runtime context.
